path.description: JSON Pointer into the draft, e.g. '/identity/title' or '/objects/3/latex'. For add, point at the array, e.g. '/objects'.

value_json.description: The new value encoded as a JSON string, for replace and add; null for remove and flag.

reason.description: For a flag: what is wrong and what you would change, in one sentence. Otherwise a short reason.

quote.description: Copied exactly from the page text, 8 to 300 characters.

items.description: A verbatim passage from the paper and the page it is on.

evidence.description: At least one verbatim quote that shows the correction is right; a correction without one is discarded.

description: Corrections to a draft of paper-artifacts. Only correct or flag; every correction needs verbatim evidence.
